bull_points.claim: Absolute EBITDA has kept rising through the de-rate — $1,311M FY25 to $1,337M LTM Mar-2026 — while margin only slipped from 24% to 20-21%, showing earnings are compounding, not eroding, even as the multiple collapsed.

bull_points.claim: The Insights subscription engine still shows healthy stickiness — GTS ex-Fed wallet retention 99% and GBS 98% in Q1 2026 — indicating the core recurring base is not structurally breaking.

key_unknowns: Segment-level EBITDA is not disclosed — the filing segments revenue (Insights 78%, Conferences 10%, Consulting 9%) but discloses no segment EBITDA, so profitability concentration inside Insights is opaque (a bearish visibility gap).

Forward/adjusted EV-EBITDA and adjusted EPS are not in the revised 99.1 guidance, so the trailing 8.0x cannot be cleanly reconciled to a forward basis — overshoot-vs-terminal remains unresolved on the multiple itself.
FCF sign at the latest-quarter granularity is flagged UNKNOWN in survival_capacity even though LTM FCF is positive; the runway framing is 'not assessable' per that leg.
Whether contract value actually re-accelerates as management guides ('we expect contract value will accelerate') is unverified — the next results print (est. 2026-11-03) is the test.

The peer set is HETEROGENEOUS (market caps span $960M-$123.7B, 129x) so every peer-median multiple must be treated as a confidence-gated input, not a clean benchmark — the earned-vs-residual split cannot be read off the median alone.
Durability of the Digital Markets divestiture impact and whether the $150M goodwill impairment signals further write-down risk in acquired assets is not quantified beyond the single charge.

business_description.value: Gartner, Inc. provides business and technology insights to support decision-making and performance on an organization’s mission-critical priorities in the United States, Canada, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and internationally. It operates through three segments: Insights, Conferences, and Consulting. The Insights segment delivers insights through subscription services, such as access to published content, data and benchmarks, and direct access to a network of business and technology experts. The Conferences segment enables executives and teams to learn, share, and network through its Symposium/Xpo series and peer-driven sessions, as well as through its conferences focused on specific business roles and topics. The Consulting segment provides technology-driven strategic initiatives, including custom analysis and on-the-ground support to senior executives. This segment also offers actionable solutions for IT-related priorities, including IT cost optimization, digital transformation, and IT sourcing optimization.
